name: National Weather Service (NWS) API
rate_limits: Not publicly documented; generous for typical use. Requests return error if exceeded, retry after ~5 seconds
notes: Truly free US government weather API. No API key, no registration, no fees. REST/JSON design. OpenAPI spec available at api.weather.gov/openapi.json. Three-step forecast workflow: (1) /points/{lat},{lon} to get grid, (2) use returned forecast URL. Key endpoints: /points, /gridpoints/{wfo}/{x},{y}/forecast, /stations/{id}/observations/latest, /alerts. Coordinates limited to 4 decimal places. US coverage only. AI-friendly: consistent JSON-LD responses, well-structured metadata. ISO-8601 timestamps throughout.
